title: dryopteris asplenioides
intro: Dryopteris asplenioides, commonly known as Asplenium asplenioides or the Eastern Lady Fern, is a type of fern plant belonging to the Dryopteridaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, treating respiratory issues, and alleviating menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Dryopteris asplenioides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
